evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks.
